feature: Create Prime Contracts through AI Assistant chat

flows.name: Manual SOV create
steps: Describe the Prime Contract and manual SOV rows
flows.expectedOutcome: The contract and every manual SOV row persist and appear on the canonical detail route

flows.name: Budget-backed SOV create
steps: Request project budget as the SOV source
flows.expectedOutcome: The created SOV rows preserve their canonical project budget-code relationships

flows.name: Workbook-backed SOV create
flows.expectedOutcome: Only selected valid workbook rows persist through the canonical Prime Contract creation flow

flows.name: Failure and recovery
steps: Trigger a deterministic invalid, duplicate, permission, or partial-write state
flows.expectedOutcome: No silent or duplicate write occurs and the recovery state survives reload

checks: Draft source and validation are readable
Failure and recovery states are explicit
All mobile controls meet the 44px target

claims.description: The initiating chat request is captured
The complete Prime Contract draft is captured before approval
The exact write plan and explicit approval state are captured
The created contract receipt and canonical detail route are captured
Contract fields, SOV rows, and budget links are verified in the database
Conversation reload preserves the widget state
Validation, permission, duplicate, and partial-write recovery are verified
Tablet and mobile visual review is complete
Durable service, tool, widget, and journey regression tests exist
